steps.input:
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    wall = 2
    axis = idx = None
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == wall for v in row):
            axis, idx = 0, r
            break
    if axis is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if all(grid[r][c] == wall for r in range(h)):
                axis, idx = 1, c
                break
    if axis is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != wall)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (wall, bg)]
    if not pts:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c, _ in pts:
        out[r][c] = bg
    if axis == 0:
        coords = [r for r, _, _ in pts]
        if min(coords) > idx:  # object below the divider
            d = idx + 1 - min(coords)
            for r, c, color in pts: out[r + d][c] = color
            trail = max(coords) + d + 1
        else:  # object above the divider
            d = idx - 1 - max(coords)
            for r, c, color in pts: out[r + d][c] = color
            trail = min(coords) + d - 1
        for c in range(w): out[trail][c] = 8
    else:
        coords = [c for _, c, _ in pts]
        if min(coords) > idx:  # object right of the divider
            d = idx + 1 - min(coords)
            for r, c, color in pts: out[r][c + d] = color
            trail = max(coords) + d + 1
        else:  # object left of the divider
            d = idx - 1 - max(coords)
            for r, c, color in pts: out[r][c + d] = color
            trail = min(coords) + d - 1
        for r in range(h): out[r][trail] = 8
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sol',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print(*mod.transform(T),sep='\n')
